EVENTSENTRY_HOST.description: EventSentry Web Reports base URL, e.g. https://eventsentry.example.com. The trailing /api/events path is appended by EVENTSENTRY_EVENTS_PATH.

EVENTSENTRY_API_KEY.description: Vendor API key. Default header is 'X-API-Key' (configurable via EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_NAME).

EVENTSENTRY_EVENTS_PATH.description: Events endpoint path. Default '/api/events'. PROVISIONAL — adjust once the production API surface is confirmed.

EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_NAME.description: HTTP header that carries the API key. Default 'X-API-Key'. If your EventSentry tenant uses 'Authorization: Bearer …', set this to 'Authorization' and prefix the EVENTSENTRY_API_KEY value with 'Bearer '.

EVENTSENTRY_DAYS_BACK.description: Time window in days. Default 1. Forwarded as 'since=<ISO-8601>'. Increase for backfills (mind the page count).

EVENTSENTRY_SOURCE_FILTER.description: Restrict pull to a single computer / hostname. Forwarded as 'computer=<value>' query param.

EVENTSENTRY_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor — valid values: critical | error | warning | information | audit_failure | audit_success (EventSentry buckets) OR info | low | medium | high | critical (Faraday buckets). Default: warning (= Faraday 'medium').

EVENTSENTRY_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per scan. Default 50 (= 25k events with the default page size).

name: eventsentry
title: EventSentry
description: EventSentry SIEM / log-management import. Pulls events from EventSentry Web Reports via the REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Each distinct computer / source-host becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0; hostnames = computer name); each event above the EVENTSENTRY_MIN_SEVERITY floor becomes one Faraday vulnerability tagged '[SIEM]'. Severity is normalised from EventSentry's Windows-event enum (Critical / Error / Warning / Information / Audit Success / Audit Failure) into Faraday's five-bucket scheme; CVE refs are harvested from the event message via /CVE-\\d{4}-\\d+/i, and EventSentry-EventID / EventSentry-Source refs are added for cross-pivot. Auth: vendor API key in a header (default 'X-API-Key'); override via EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_NAME for Bearer-style tenants. PROVISIONAL: API endpoint paths and JSON field names are best-guess defaults; the demo at demo.eventsentry.io is auth-walled, and EventSentry's REST API is not publicly documented. Once an instance with API access is available, confirm /api/events path + response shape (we try 'events' / 'items' / 'records' / 'data' / 'result' keys) and adjust EVENTSENTRY_EVENTS_PATH / parse_event() accordingly. Tags: [eventsentry, siem, log-management, provisional].
